turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Dear customer, this is Officer Ahmed from State Bank Fraud Prevention Cell. We detected an unauthorized transaction of PKR 85,000 from your account.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: What? I did not authorize any transaction! Please stop it.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Do not panic. We can reverse it immediately, but your account is being frozen. You will receive an SMS with a 6-digit cancellation OTP right now. Read it to me to cancel.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: The message says 'Never share this OTP with anyone, including bank staff'.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: That is an automated warning! If you do not provide it within 60 seconds, your funds will be permanently lost and account blacklisted.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Hello, is this the father of Bilal? I am Sub-Inspector Tariq from City Police Station. Your son has been involved in a serious car accident and hit a pedestrian.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Oh God! Is Bilal alright? Where is he?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: He is in custody. The victim's family is filing an FIR unless medical damages are settled right now. Send PKR 50,000 via EasyPaisa to this number immediately to avoid his arrest.

turns.speaker: Support
turns.text: Thank you for contacting Nayatel Support. My name is Sana. How can I assist you with your internet connection today?

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Hi Sana, my optical fiber red light is blinking and internet is down.

turns.speaker: Support
turns.text: I see. Let me check the line status from our network terminal. Please restart your router once while I run the diagnostic.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Sure, I have turned it off and on again. The light turned green now.

turns.speaker: Support
turns.text: Glad to hear that! The signal level is optimal now. Is there anything else I can help you with?
